# Find Quotes

Find exact spoken quotes and clip-ready moments on podcasts and YouTube: resolve the name you give to an id (with your own words as context), search the indexed transcripts for the passage, then read the transcript lines around it for the verbatim words — quoted exactly, never paraphrased — with the speaker, the show, the episode date, a timestamped watch link and clip start/end in seconds. Runs entirely through the remote Arcmira MCP server on your own account: metered credits, caption and Premium (paid-plan) transcript reads, and one feedback send if something was wrong.
